32-shape-morphing-gallery.visual_critic_note: Clean grid with a deliberate Tol bright palette, but 5 of 9 cells render blank at screenshot time due to staggered timeouts up to 2400ms — making half the gallery look broken on load.
32-shape-morphing-gallery.encoding_integrity_note: Purely a technique demo with no quantitative axes — bar states maintain zero baselines and d3.pack handles area-correct circle sizing, but all domains are hardcoded and six of nine panels appear blank in the screenshot due to staggered initialization timing.
32-shape-morphing-gallery.stress_test_note: Purely automated animation gallery with no user-input event handlers (no brush, zoom, drag, touch), so all five interaction stress-test categories are inapplicable; the only minor gap is the absence of .interrupt() in loopMorph before each new transition, but since transitions are strictly chained via on('end') callbacks they never overlap in practice.
32-shape-morphing-gallery.cognitive_load_note: 9-cell gallery with simultaneous looping animations (1500ms morph, 300ms stagger) is manageable because each cell is a self-contained unit and the gallery format invites sequential browsing rather than parallel tracking, but concurrent peripheral motion across all 9 cells could distract when the viewer is focused on one — the 3 empty cells in the screenshot also suggest a render-timing issue that may leave the grid partially blank on first load.
